title.zh: 使用元工具优化智能体工作流

inclusion_reason.zh: AWO 的轨迹挖掘与 meta-tool 编译器可把重复工具路径沉淀为确定性运行时原语，减少中间 LLM 控制开销。
inclusion_reason.en: AWO's trace mining and meta-tool compiler turn repeated tool paths into deterministic runtime primitives that remove intermediate LLM control overhead.

abstract.zh: Agent Workflow Optimization（AWO）从既有执行轨迹中发现重复工具调用序列，并把它们编译成确定性的复合 meta-tool。一次 meta-tool 调用替代多轮 LLM 推理和工具往返，从而缩短执行路径、降低成本并减少幻觉暴露点。
abstract.en: Agent Workflow Optimization (AWO) mines recurring tool-call sequences from execution traces and compiles them into deterministic composite meta-tools. One meta-tool invocation replaces several LLM reasoning and tool round trips, shortening paths and reducing cost and hallucination exposure.

problem.zh: Agent 经常重复相同的多工具模式，却每次重新进行中间 LLM 推理，造成额外调用、端到端延迟和沿途幻觉或失败。
problem.en: Agents repeatedly execute the same multi-tool patterns but regenerate intermediate reasoning every time, adding calls, end-to-end latency, and opportunities for hallucination or failure.

approach.zh: AWO 分析历史轨迹，识别高频且可确定组合的工具子序列，生成带固定数据流和错误处理的 meta-tool，并让 Agent 在后续任务中直接选择它。
approach.en: AWO analyzes traces, identifies frequent tool subsequences that can be composed deterministically, generates meta-tools with fixed data flow and error handling, and exposes them for later agent selection.

system_design.zh: 离线轨迹分析器产生候选模式，编译器把经验证序列封装为新工具契约，运行时工具注册表同时提供原子工具与 meta-tool，并记录收益供后续更新。
system_design.en: An offline trace analyzer proposes patterns, a compiler wraps validated sequences in new tool contracts, and the runtime registry exposes both atomic and meta-tools while logging realized benefit for future updates.

key_results.zh: 两个 Agent 基准上的实验报告 AWO 减少 LLM 调用，并同时提升任务成功率，说明压缩冗余路径可兼顾效率与鲁棒性。
key_results.en: On two agent benchmarks, AWO is reported to reduce LLM calls while improving task success, indicating that collapsing redundant paths can help both efficiency and robustness.

limitations.zh: meta-tool 只适合稳定、可组合且副作用明确的序列；工具版本或业务规则变化会使封装过期，过度合并也可能削弱 Agent 的自适应分支能力。
limitations.en: Meta-tools suit stable, composable sequences with understood side effects; tool or policy changes can stale the wrapper, and over-composition may remove adaptive branching the agent still needs.

notes.zh: 两项基准、原始流程基线和调用/成功率结果来自官方摘要；基准名、模型、工具集、时延与成本待全文审计。
notes.en: Two benchmarks, the original-workflow baseline, and call/success results come from the official abstract; benchmark names, models, tools, latency, and cost await full-text audit.
